- **Funnel tabs:** The rows were all `@example.com`, utm-probe or the placeholder. I backed them up first and deleted bottom-up. A re-read of all six tabs finds no matches. The backup is `workshop-plan/ops/t107_deleted_rows.json`.
- **ops.db:** It never held a probe attendee, so there was nothing to remove.
- **Worker D1:** I deleted the two `example.com` test attendees (`you@` and `adi@`) and their 11 dependent rows. The backup is `t107_d1_deleted_rows.json`, with the tokens redacted.
- **Tantra Tracker:** I did not touch it. It is rewritten from those sources on its next sync, so the deleted rows should drop out then.
- **Probe re-runs:** I did not re-run `probe-live-wiring.mjs` or `probe-checkout-currency.mjs`. Both already ran on 2026-10-09 and would only add new rows to clean.
- **Apps Script trashing:** The stored token is adi@growthclub.org with `drive.file` scope, so it can't reach the boards@fintechcircle.com projects. T-380 is assigned to Nelbin for that.
- **T-193:** No T-193 record exists in `tasks.json`, so there was nothing to close.
